title: Longshoreman, liquor sales and the Glazer job
summary: Union trouble led him to work three years as a longshoreman, then liquor sales, then drug wholesaler sales until about 1990.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: Day jobs: musicians working outside music
